overview: This bill makes two small fixes to the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2026, the yearly law that sets defense policy. First, it rewrites the licensing requirement for military lawyers, called judge advocates, so they must hold a law license in good standing that allows them to practice law. Second, it removes the word 'posthumous' from the heading of a section that authorizes awarding the Distinguished Service Cross, a high military honor, to Isaac 'Ike' Camacho for heroism in Vietnam. As of March 24, 2026, it had passed the Senate and was waiting at the House desk.
for: Supporters say the bill simply corrects drafting problems so the defense law works as intended, including properly describing an award for a Vietnam veteran.
against: Critics have little to object to, though some may note that technical fixes like these show the cost of rushing large defense bills through without careful review.
